commit.message: Bind recent acceptance workflow to reviewed store source
docs: preserve empty network receipt as raw evidence

fix(ci): bind current QROM checks to reviewed dependency locks

Retain the November 7 and 9 observations and reproduce a separate current fixture. Require the exact three reviewed implementation drift paths and only the two independently pinned semantics provenance changes.

Keep every qualification limit and historical failure. Verified 22 semantics, 31 closure, 13 current CI and 67 corpus controls; the finite generator output exactly matches the new fixture.

fix(ci): validate native-completion budget observations by phase

Keep historical v2 refusal evidence separate from current v3 completion controls. Require the original CPU settlement, completed first commit, exact successor page, postcommit cancellation or complete successor import, and the unchanged crash fence.

All 43 reader controls pass. A separate passive check accepts the three exact original native stdout/process records; their original failed aggregate report is retained. Native rosters, paired-input equality and runtime budgets are unchanged.

merge: preserve concurrent History CI corrections with audited source fixes

Integrate the observed e40d7071 candidate commit through an ordinary two-parent merge. Retain the complete 41-name History roster, its original ignored child, and exact successful diagnostic-bearing libtest records while preserving local QROM dependency bindings and native-completion budget reader corrections.

The native three-way tree contains only the five reviewed incoming paths; the research corpus retains all 2462 current pins and 2364 required paths. Current workflow parser and roster controls pass, and all current corpus bindings verify. No Rust runtime, deadline, budget or historical outcome is changed.

Fix reviewed hash-purpose descriptor binding

The source guard correctly refused the proof descriptor after the reviewed
standalone verifier lock-map alignment. Rebind that one descriptor and the
fixed reviewed source-map digest while preserving all19 use semantics,
all31 input paths, refusal of automatic repinning and HOLD_NO_GO flags.

Refresh only the three corresponding source-corpus blob identities and
record the exact review and validation scope in the single development plan.
The existing33 controls, positive purpose inspection and research-source
integrity checks pass. No native workload or production qualification is
claimed; original failed CI observations remain intact.

Merge current candidate with retained audit corrections

Preserve both current-candidate history and the independent AR budget, hash-purpose, and QROM fixture corrections. Resolve seven conflicts with the reviewed combined candidates.

This local integration checkpoint retains original failures. Remaining source review, current pin rebinding, targeted fixes, and required validation are pending.

Fix retained control coverage and audited source regressions

Keep the worker artifact identity snapshot from initial validation, retain store readiness ordering, restore ten current-stage controls, require all21 Cell CI control names, and align two synthetic throughput rows with the unchanged native schedule.

The worker regressions and bounded readback controls retain their original failures and fixed results. Final source pin rebinding, remaining review, and complete required validation are pending.

Bind current durable reader to reviewed endpoint witness gate

Keep the strict full selected-body binding and reject old-body fallback, policy bypass, ignored refusal and late namespace checks. Preserve every original evidence-control method and add six independent negative cases.

The exact current source body is statically reviewed. Current finite controls and final required validation remain pending.

Separate frozen PQ models from current source correspondence

Retain the exact v1 model and source lock and the v2 composition register. Add an explicit current 21-path correspondence and current-v3 composition contract binding the reviewed 46-path root inventory and exact 66-path union. Keep all arithmetic, unknown bounds, HOLD results and qualification refusals unchanged.

Retain all original control methods, add 25 current correspondence controls, and register four new mandatory inputs. Final corpus/source pin updates and integrated validation remain pending.

Close SQLite evidence connections after each transaction

Retain the existing SQLite commit and rollback context while explicitly closing each reader and fixture connection on all exit paths. Preserve all 77 test methods and all other statements and assertions under an independently checked AST comparison.

The prior run passed all 77 controls and retained 121 ResourceWarnings. Validate the resource repair against the original controls without suppressing warnings.

Assert the current PQ report at its explicit namespace

The original 58-control run retained one KeyError because the current report was passed to the legacy term-results helper. Keep the full nested frozen-model helper and directly assert all five false qualification flags plus HOLD and the null failure bound on the outer current report.

All 58 method names and the other 57 method bodies remain unchanged. No production reader, frozen lock, resource bound or probability assertion changes.

Revalidate the persisted SP27 native process at readback

Bind the exact prepared binary, selector and ordered flags, a strictly typed zero exit code, and literal false timeout after the existing raw-readback check. This prevents unchanged stdout and report bytes from hiding altered process evidence.

Preserve all 36 original methods, original error ordering, resource limits and qualification flags. The same 40-method finite synthetic registry reproduced 40 tamper subtest failures on the original controllers and passed on the candidate. No native campaign result is reclassified.

Require matching JSON types in complete source receipt pairs

Python dictionary equality treated true/1/1.0 and false/0/0.0 as unchanged values after only the before receipt was typed. Require the same closed fields, exact value types and equal values on both receipts before the existing source-contract checks.

All original 27 methods and error ordering remain unchanged. Three added JSON-only controls reproduce eight original type-substitution failures and pass with this patch. Resource limits, phase timing, costs, null observations and qualification flags are preserved.

Bind reviewed corrective source inventories and current audit documentation

The current authority44 and lifetime20 maps still pointed to the prior Node store bytes. Bind the independently checked fc39 source checkpoint, update strict reader and independent test constants, and add the former authority revision to the retained negative cases. The selected QROM145 bytes and frozen historical namespaces remain unchanged.

Refresh only reviewed current corpus pins, retain every existing required path, and add the four explicit current PQ correspondence/composition reader and contract paths. Correct stale document introductions and preserve dated historical observations. Record actual finite control results and the still pending hosted gates, historical review and protected merge in the sole development plan.
